interpretation: Run 5 does not replace the newer Run-4 packed runtime. The packed E4M3 track has native L1 execution evidence but one-seed controlled quality; the grouped track has stronger five-seed L2C quality evidence but only Python/reference KV execution. Combining the best properties and validating them in one packed runtime is the next controlled milestone.
